title: Source-level stationary-semigroup well-posedness synthesis
question: Does immutable PAH-001 itself select one unique finite stationary semigroup to which the PAH-OMC-020 ordered-correlation proposition can refer, without importing a separately versioned successor completion?

fixed_scope.source: Immutable strategy/pa-hyp/PAH-001-v1.json at the pinned SHA-256.
fixed_scope.objective: The original PAH finite stationary semigroup followed by the registered j-before-n local-correlation comparison to the R-512 minimal closure.
fixed_scope.logic: Use the exact R-552 finite generator nonuniqueness and R-553 positive-time separation, then test whether R-558 can be used as a source repair.

source_ambiguity.evidence: R-552 records two source-compatible root-multiplicity completions with different exact finite generator derivatives on the same invariant cylinder.
source_ambiguity.consequence: The immutable source does not select one finite generator or stationary semigroup.

positive_time_separation.evidence: R-553 propagates the R-552 derivative gap to existential positive-time separation of the two finite semigroup orbits.
positive_time_separation.consequence: The ambiguity is not removable by identifying the two semigroups at positive external Markov time.

successor_non_attribution.evidence: R-558 classifies PAH-OMC-001 as a constructed researcher successor with SOURCE_OWNER_INELIGIBLE authority status.
successor_non_attribution.consequence: The successor cannot be silently used to choose the original PAH-001 semigroup.

decision_rule.negative: If source ambiguity and positive-time separation hold while every available completion is non-source-authorized, then the original immutable PAH-001 stationary-semigroup proposition is not a single well-posed theorem.
decision_rule.scope: This is a source-level formulation negative only. It is not a no-go for an explicitly owner-fixed successor model.
decision_rule.reopen: Reopen the original-source statement only if PAH-001 itself changes by a new pinned version or an owner-authorized completion is explicitly admitted as a new model.

non_claims: This does not refute convergence for every owner-fixed successor completion.
This does not prove or refute the R-512 limit after a future source-authorized completion is supplied.
No new carrier, rate, state, time interpretation, comparison map, counterterm or limit order is introduced.
No physical Pre-A, spacetime, QFT, gravity, continuum, Yang--Mills, mass-gap or TOE conclusion is made.
next_single_question: Will an owner-authorized, hash-pinned successor completion be admitted as a separately named model, or will the original PAH-001 source remain the final object under the scoped source-level negative?
revisit_condition: Reopen only after a parent hash changes or an owner-authorized completion is explicitly admitted; do not repeat the same R-552 witness without new source status.
